w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Spool is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Terms of Service.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Callback stops at the boundary — pacing, unwilling. Something else is already here. It's still out there.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: A frame of it hangs in the air. Then another. It's buffering.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Big Ugly." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: The Tide Clock. The tidal pools are rich and the causeway is drowning. Harvest while the water lets you. The tide doesn't negotiate, and the cameras love a deadline."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (10/7/6), with 6 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 6 · Forage 11 · Craft 9 · Talk 15 · Explore 38 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Zoe Adams ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
